title.narrative: Plantwise Supporting Farmers in Burundi

description.narrative: Please also note that this activity relates to (complements) the Nuffic funded project 'Plantwise training to improve the agricultural advisory system for integrated pest and disease management in Burundi' (see Document Link).

The overall project objective is to strengthen the capacity of agricultural advisory systems in Burundi to support farmers in managing plant health through an environmentally friendly and cost-effective manner using practices that promote integrated crop management. Specifically, the project will support the establishment of a network of plant clinics to enhance farmers' access to information on sustainable management of plant health. It will allow creation of a data collection and management system that enables plant health stakeholders in Burundi to more effectively monitor production constraints at field level and coordinate higher-level responses to key problems. It will also support the development or enhancement of agricultural university/college curricula that address existing gaps in uptake of information about new innovations and technologies in pest management.
